fit_policy: No fitting, model selection, calibration, plant-contract derivation or search expansion on TEST.
simulation_observation_role: CONTEXT_ONLY until the dedicated paired monthly evaluator; legacy daily hypothesis labels are not used.
monthly_support: Identical approved daily dates for observed/A/B Q. Require at least 0.9 of calendar days. Keep all 60 calendar keys and explicitly mark excluded months; never impute.
estimated_sensitivity: Exclude A,e days, recompute paired observed/A/B Q and eligibility; apply frozen C/D with the recomputed physical baseline input. Weather/model-state features retain full-month support. No refitting. This sensitivity changes the monthly evaluation support, not the primary predictions.
features: Apply the frozen ML protocol formulas, ordered schemas and TRAIN scalers; stress absence is 0 with availability fraction. First replay the 96 development feature rows through the backend and require agreement with the frozen development predictions.
bootstrap: Paired circular moving blocks, 12 calendar months, 2000 replicates, seed 42, Python random.Random.randrange. Draw ceil(60/12) block starts per replicate, wrap around, concatenate and truncate to 60; apply the common eligibility mask after resampling so gaps are not closed.
confidence_interval: Two-sided 95% percentile interval with linear interpolation at (n-1)*p. Primary delta is RMSE(A)-RMSE(D) in m3/s. Percentage reduction also reported using paired replicate denominators.
decision: H1_SUPPORTED only if all 2000 primary replicates are defined and the primary absolute RMSE reduction interval lower bound is strictly positive. Otherwise H1_NOT_SUPPORTED, or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if fewer than two eligible months. No 15% threshold, no iid t-test.
secondary: B-A, C-A, D-B, D-C intervals descriptive and unadjusted; simple-reference coefficients come unchanged from TRAIN.
interpretation: One basin, fixed experimental management and an exploratory physical reference that failed calibration bias acceptance. Statistical improvement in held-out outlet Q does not validate physiology, water balance or FSPM feature attribution.
reuse: After completion, verify and reuse frozen artifacts; no silent reruns, tuning or replacement of TEST results.
